title: The Feed's four shortcuts are soft feature buttons, and the palette's deep blues soften to airy teal and lavender

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 on localhost /feed after SCAN-907: I don't like this harsh blue, that's not the vibe; make the 4 features into beautiful feature buttons with elements from the design system.

detail: SCAN-907's deep sweep (#17788A, #1F5FB8, #5B3FD0) painted the shortcut icon chips navy and royal blue, and its #1F6FA8 accent made link text bright blue. The alias layer softens both: the deep sweep runs mid aqua, soft sky and lavender, the light accent is a seaglass-leaning teal. The four Feed shortcuts (Your Spaces or Your Circles, Events, Messages, Practices) become feature buttons: the glass panel, a round orb in a new --fq-orb-soft aqua-periwinkle-lavender gradient holding the glyph in --fq-orb-ink, the label over a one-line caption (What you run, What’s happening, Your conversations, Keep your rhythm), even heights and the existing hover lift.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency.css','utf8');const m=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8');const f=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/feed/feed-body.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(/1F5FB8|1F6FA8/i.test(a))bad.push('the harsh blue stops are still in the palette');if(!a.includes('--fq-orb-soft:'))bad.push('no soft orb token');if(!/SCAN-913[\s\S]*\.fa-quick a svg\{[^}]*var\(--fq-orb-soft\)/.test(m))bad.push('the shortcut glyphs do not sit in the soft orb');if(!f.includes('fa-quick-t')||!f.includes('note:'))bad.push('the shortcuts have no caption');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-913: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
